newsitem.title: DUBAI: Standard Bank London gets Dubai rep office.
newsitem.headline: Standard Bank London gets Dubai rep office.

text.p: Standard Bank London, part of South Africa's Standard Bank Investment Corp, is setting up a representative office in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates, its Dubai general manager said.

"We are setting up a representative office promoting treasury and trade financing services with particular emphasis on gold," Jeffrey Rhodes told Reuters, adding the bank recently received a representative licence from the UAE Central Bank.
Initially, the office will be staffed by four or five people, he said.
Dubai is one of the world's biggest redistribution points for gold, particularly into India -- the single largest market for the metal.
"Standard Bank London is the first South African-owned bank to operate in Dubai, providing the perfect bridge to bring the (gold) supply side and a major demand side together," Rhodes said.

South Africa is the world's biggest gold producer, with output of around 500 tonnes a year. Last year Dubai imported some 350 tonnes of the metal, mostly from Switzerland and Britain. Analysts expect the emirate to import around 450 tonnes this year.
